ideas.pitch: A local static and dynamic analysis tool that parses binary binaries to extract custom ROP gadgets and automate CTF payload generation for stack buffer overflows.
ideas.title: HexTrace: Automated Binary Exploit Pattern Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the Binary Exploitation and Reverse Engineering domains directly with genuinely hard engineering, automating tedious tasks that consume CTF teams' time during jeopardy rounds.

ideas.pitch: A unified CTF cryptography toolkit that automatically tests for common modular arithmetic vulnerabilities, common modulus attacks, and weak public exponents.
ideas.title: CryptoSleuth: Automated RSA & Elliptic Curve Attack Orchestrator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the Cryptography domain with a focus on speed, allowing solo players or small teams to instantly identify and solve classic CTF crypto challenges.

ideas.pitch: An OSINT framework that rapidly crawls image EXIF data, social media handles, and historical DNS records to trace digital artifacts during time-sensitive CTF investigations.
ideas.title: OSINT-Mesh: Real-Time Digital Footprint and Metadata Aggregator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Speeds up investigation workflows in the OSINT and Digital Forensics domains, mirroring the efficient data-processing patterns seen in winning analytical tool hacks.

ideas.pitch: A localized web security tool that identifies complex SQLi and prototype pollution vulnerabilities by leveraging context-aware payload mutation.
ideas.title: WebFuzz-AI: Intelligent Payload Generator for Edge Web Vulnerabilities
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting Web Exploitation, this tool applies automated hardening and defense-in-depth concepts to discover edge-case application logic flaws.

ideas.pitch: A fast forensics dashboard that parses memory dumps to detect hidden processes, injected DLLs, and suspicious network connections using heuristic signature matching.
ideas.title: MemoryDump-Inspector: Automated Volatile Artifact Correlator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides an edge in the Digital Forensics domain through deep systems engineering and instant report generation, matching the rigor of high-scoring automation tools.
